# Third-Party Assets

All retained third-party artwork is stored under `Assets/Art/External/Imported`.
No executable, Unity package, ripped Plants vs. Zombies artwork, or AI-generated
image is included. Download archives and rejected candidates are not committed.

## The Zombie - Free Sprites

- Asset: The Zombie - Free Sprites (male character frames only)
- Author: pzUH / GameArt2D
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/the-zombie-free-sprites
- License: CC0-1.0
- Used for: Normal Zombie and Conehead shared animated body
- Retained: 45 PNG frames (Idle 15, Walk 10, Attack 8, Dead 12)

## Peashooter search result

No free candidate found during the search met the requested recognizable
Peashooter silhouette, visual quality, and clear-license requirements. The
existing in-project placeholder remains in use with presentation-only idle and
shoot motion. Best paid candidate reviewed:

- Asset: Seed shooting animated plant
- Author: RobertBrooks
- Source: https://www.gamedevmarket.net/asset/seed-shooting-animated-plant
- Price observed: USD 4
- License: GameDev Market Pro License
- Status: not purchased, downloaded, or integrated
